title: Treatment of Androgenic Alopecia in Males
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the change in terminal hair count at 16 and 26 weeks compared to baseline measurements.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of androgenetic alopecia
* Fitzpatrick Skin Types I-IV
* Norwood-Hamilton IIa to V
* Active hair loss within last 12 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Photosensitivity to laser light
* Malignancy in the target area
